scripts.install:all: npm --prefix agent-core ci && npm --prefix platform ci && npm --prefix model-gateway ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.build: npm --prefix agent-core run build && npm --prefix platform run build && npm --prefix model-gateway run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix agent-core test && npm --prefix platform test && npm --prefix model-gateway test
scripts.codex:artifact: docker buildx build --platform linux/arm64 --target codex-artifact --output type=local,dest=.runtime/agentcore .
scripts.agentcore:build: docker buildx build --platform linux/arm64 --target runtime --load -t truex-agentcore:local .
